## Changelog

### Compatibility

* Docker-backed image operations require **Docker Engine 19.03 or newer (API 1.40+)**. Upgrade older daemons before using the Docker backend. ([#7973](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7973))
* Restore shared build synchronization to prevent concurrent builders from publishing duplicate images. Registry builds use the public synchronization service by default; local builds use host file locks. Synchronization failures stop the operation. Configure an alternative with `--synchronization` / `-S` or `WERF_SYNCHRONIZATION`; the `werf synchronization` command is available again. ([#7989](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7989))

### Docker

* Respect remote Docker contexts and SSH endpoints when selecting the daemon. ([#7971](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7971))
* Stop backend initialization from hanging on an unresponsive Docker socket. Keep chart-only `werf plan`, `werf lint`, `werf helm get-autogenerated-values` and `werf bundle publish` independent of Docker, and let registry-only commands work with an unavailable or unsupported daemon. ([#7981](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7981), [#7988](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7988))

### Build, cache and export

* Reuse unchanged Dockerfile build contexts and avoid copying the same context for every image. ([#7953](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7953), [#7980](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7980))
* Rebuild images when Git-tracked files are renamed or Git mappings swap contents, instead of reusing an incorrect cached image. ([#7940](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7940), [#7947](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7947))
* Make newly published stage tags visible to the same build immediately, avoiding redundant stage rebuilds. Rebuild rejected stages instead of exhausting retries against the same invalid cache entry. ([#7965](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7965), [#7979](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7979))
* Respect Git mapping owner/group settings with Docker, including directories added by incremental updates. ([#7972](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7972), [#7977](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7977))
* Run requested build introspection even when an image is reused from the content cache. ([#7967](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7967))
* Export cached images with local and final repositories, resolve final-repository images from build reports, and export multi-platform images from the final repository. ([#7959](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7959), [#7964](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7964), [#7983](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7983))
* Report invalid patterns in `.dockerignore` and `.containerignore`, including Dockerfile-specific variants, as build errors naming the file and pattern instead of panicking. ([#7992](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7992))
* Keep provenance generation disabled during parallel Dockerfile builds. ([#7941](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7941))
* Reject invalid imports in images based on `scratch` during configuration validation. ([#7944](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7944))
* Release temporary source containers after staged Dockerfile `COPY --from` operations with Buildah, preventing container accumulation and pinned source images. ([#7938](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7938))
* Keep Git deploy keys isolated across SSH aliases and report when SSH connection multiplexing cannot be enabled. ([#7945](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7945), [#7984](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7984))
* Preserve reusable Git caches when a command is cancelled. ([#7966](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7966))
* Reduce repeated registry token requests, including GitLab tag deletion, while obtaining fresh tokens for scopes requested by redirected registry hosts. ([#7955](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7955), [#7979](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7979), [a84a30b](https://github.com/werf/werf/commit/a84a30b1f2d1c89109954fbe7aae7f7c906cb75c))
* Reduce repetitive build and debug output. Keep registry tag-cache request counters separate from stage counts in console summaries and the optional `RegistryCache` build-report section. ([#7985](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7985), [#7987](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7987))

### Cleanup

* Leave cleanup metadata unchanged during dry runs. ([#7960](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7960))
* Preserve images published to the final repository by concurrent builds. ([#7975](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7975))
* Fix host purge cleanup of platform-specific Stapel containers and their unused volumes. ([#7969](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7969), [#7978](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7978))

### Deploy

* Honor Docker-config credentials for private OCI chart dependencies during chart-only `werf converge`. ([#7974](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7974))
* Keep structured `werf release` output machine-readable at the default log level. ([#7961](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7961))
* Honor retention policies on live Kubernetes resources, even when the chart does not contain the annotation. ([#7958](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7958))
* Fix recreation of StatefulSets and other resources with resource-specific immutable-field validation when `werf.io/delete-policy: before-creation-if-immutable` is set. ([#7994](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7994))

### Documentation

* Use explicitly tagged base images, including Go images, in build examples. ([#7942](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7942), [#7946](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7946))
* Correct the Helm configuration migration instructions: `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` points to the parent of the `helm` directory, not to the previous `HELM_CONFIG_HOME` directory itself. ([#7986](https://github.com/werf/werf/pull/7986))

## Installation

To install `werf` we strongly recommend following [these instructions](https://werf.io/getting_started/).

Alternatively, you can download `werf` binaries from here:
* [Linux amd64](https://tuf.werf.io/targets/releases/3.6.2/linux-amd64/bin/werf) ([PGP signature](https://tuf.werf.io/targets/signatures/3.6.2/linux-amd64/bin/werf.sig))
